hero.title: Run your rental business from one intelligent platform.
hero.lead: Payments, expenses, tenants, tasks, Smart Lock, and AI insights — all in one system.
trust.title: This is not a listings board. This is an operating system for rental businesses.
trust.lead: Ijara AI brings property, finance, team, Telegram, and smart access into one operational hub. It starts with control — not search.
problems.title: Why is rental management so hard?
problems.lead: The problem isn’t one listing or one payment. It’s fragmented processes. Every delay rolls into next month’s books.
problems.featured.title: Outstanding balances only show after payments are late
problems.featured.text: A tenant delays, the reminder comes late, and the debt grows before it hits the report. When control is manual, the numbers lag.
problems.secondary.1.title: Income and expenses are scattered
problems.secondary.1.text: Payment in one place, utilities in another spreadsheet, payroll in chat. The monthly picture never comes together.
problems.secondary.2.title: Unclear why costs went up
problems.secondary.2.text: When electricity, water, or office costs rise, you hunt for the gap by hand. The cause is found too late.
problems.rest.1.title: Tasks are assigned — completion isn’t tracked
problems.rest.1.text: Staff get the assignment; proof of completion, photos, and timing are asked for later.
problems.rest.2.title: Hard to prove room condition
problems.rest.2.text: Check-in and check-out condition turns into a verbal dispute. There’s no structured record to compare.
problems.rest.3.title: PINs and keys are managed by hand
problems.rest.3.text: Who entered when, and when a PIN should expire, lives in memory or a notebook.
problems.rest.4.title: Reports are late and expensive
problems.rest.4.text: Month-to-month comparison means assembling spreadsheets. Decisions wait.
problems.rest.5.title: Late payment breaks the chain
problems.rest.5.text: If reminder, debt, and next month’s billing aren’t linked, operations slow down.
os.title: Every workflow — in one control center
os.lead: Each module isn’t a separate app. Property, finance, team, and access control share one operational language.
os.property.title: Properties & rooms

os.finance.title: Payments & finance

audience.lead: Segments differ, but the management need is the same: occupancy, payments, team, and access control.

audience.4.title: Hotel / hostel
audience.4.useCase: Connect room turnover, staff assignments, and access control to operations.

about.title: A modern management system built for local rental businesses.
about.lead: Ijara AI was built to unify real operational challenges in Uzbekistan’s rental and property management market into one platform: finance, staff, access control, and AI analysis.
about.quote: Ijara AI isn’t just a CRM with AI bolted on. It’s a Property Management platform that helps run rental operations in a single system.
about.point.1.title: Less manual work
about.point.1.text: Payment, task, and access records move from scattered chats into the system.
about.point.2.title: Financial clarity
about.point.2.text: Income, expense, and receivables read cleanly by month.
about.point.3.title: Operational control
about.point.3.text: Room, staff, and assignment status live in one place.
about.point.4.title: Client handling
about.point.4.text: Contract, payment, and reminder are tracked in sequence.
about.point.5.title: Access is digitized

about.point.6.title: Faster decisions
about.point.6.text: AI places variance, cause, and recommendation beside the report.
